title: Project NeuroFreedom weekly claim/evidence matrix
coverage: 12–18 October 2026; latest reused daily source cutoff approximately 02:41 UTC on 18 October.
purpose: Original synthesis-level claims, not a systematic review, pooled efficacy estimate or independent study count.

claims.cohort_linkage: Calgary/Paris registry family; earlier/expanded person overlap not enumerated.
claims.actual_learning: Published marginals do not identify joint severity–QoL or a severe-at-all-visits group. Conditional overlap of 63 and 55 completion sets in 95 is 23–55.
claims.claim_retained: Separate measured tic severity, impairment and patient-reported burden are necessary for the proposed target.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Sum 95+227 as independent adults; call completion fractions retention among everyone due; infer uninterrupted severity from six-month visits.
claims.remaining_unknown: Site-specific instruments, validated severity threshold, joint outcomes, eligibility at follow-up and missingness.
claims.decision: Close current aggregate identification pass; reopen for new public methods/data dictionary or separately authorized custodian clarification.

claims.cohort_linkage: McGuire severity-benchmark and Jeon response reports use overlapping CBIT trial families; exact person overlap unavailable.
claims.actual_learning: 34/232 mixed-age completers have discordant ≥25% tic-reduction and CGI-I response labels; original and French GTS-QOL domains differ.
claims.claim_retained: Use version/language-specific native GTS-QOL domains, with separate tic severity and impairment.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Treat reliability, correlation, response threshold, severe-state classification and treatment-effect surrogacy as equivalent validation claims.
claims.remaining_unknown: Adult anchor-based QoL meaningful change; diagnosis-specific severe threshold; paired change covariance and treatment-effect surrogacy.
claims.decision: No universal threshold or tic-only burden substitution supported in this bounded source set; not proof zero association.

claims.cohort_linkage: One trial; publication, protocol and registry are linked reports, not replication.
claims.actual_learning: Primary adjusted TTS contrast −1.28, 95% CI −2.58 to 0.01, p=.053; primary superiority gate not met.
claims.claim_retained: Later time-specific exploratory tic/impairment/GTS-QOL signals warrant careful interpretation.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Confirmatory primary success, gated confirmatory non-inferiority, uniform QoL improvement, or growing efficacy from ordered estimates.
claims.remaining_unknown: Joint covariance, outcome-specific attrition, complete multiplicity correction and trial-specific life-satisfaction recoding.
claims.decision: Close aggregate audit; preserve missed criterion without equating it to no benefit.

claims.actual_learning: Internet intervention remained accessible; face-to-face participants could receive boosters.
claims.claim_retained: Time-specific longer-term observations under continued access.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Benefit after access/practice stops, treatment-free durability or disease modification.
claims.remaining_unknown: Individual ongoing practice/exposure and outcomes after a clinically appropriate cessation point.
claims.decision: Separate benefit under continued care from cessation-based claims; do not recommend stopping learned skills.

claims.cohort_linkage: Same trial as McGuire2019/2020 and parent to overlapping validation reports.
claims.actual_learning: Acute adjusted TTS advantage 3.3, 95% CI 1.4–5.2; separate secondary impairment advantage 3.9, 95% CI 0.5–7.2.
claims.claim_retained: Acute symptomatic tic benefit in the trial population.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Adult-only or persistently severe-adult generalization; direct QoL/pain benefit inferred from tic response.
claims.remaining_unknown: ≥18 subgroup; severe persistent subgroup effect; direct acute pain effect.
claims.decision: Retain established symptomatic anchor with selection and age limitations.

claims.cohort_linkage: Selected early responders from W18-C05, not a new trial.
claims.actual_learning: 12/15 returning CBIT responders positive at six months; 9/24 early responders missing; finite-cohort bounds 50–87.5%.
claims.claim_retained: A maintenance signal in returning early responders within a booster-inclusive program.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: 80% all-randomized six-month response; missing outcomes are failures; uninterrupted remission; randomized off-treatment maintenance.
claims.remaining_unknown: Missing status, actual booster attendance, later responses among initial nonresponders and joint response between visits.
claims.decision: Keep denominator/selection explicit; bounds are not confidence intervals.

claims.actual_learning: 0/12 acute randomized functional contrasts nominally significant; two response-status associations and selected follow-up positives are different estimands.
claims.claim_retained: Broader benefit is not established by this report's randomized contrasts; meaningful benefit not ruled out.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Independent replication; responder association proves mediation; nonsignificance proves no benefit or equivalence.
claims.remaining_unknown: Outcome-specific analyzed n, contrast intervals, relevant covariance and meaningful-change anchor.
claims.decision: Close reporting chain; do not pool selected analyses as randomized functional evidence.

claims.cohort_linkage: One convenience sample, 76 adults; not pooled with Taylor.
claims.actual_learning: 56 report past-or-present pain; current/worst windows differ and care denominator/subgroup counts conflict.
claims.claim_retained: Pain is a distinct directly measured burden and unmet-care topic.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Representative current/chronic adult pain prevalence; care success/failure rate; causal superiority of self-management.
claims.remaining_unknown: Correct help-seeking denominator, bounded worst-pain window, item missingness, causal treatment contrast.
claims.decision: Preserve discrepancies without selecting a corrected count.

claims.cohort_linkage: 181 respondents aged16–71, with current tic-related pain required; distinct from Małek sample.
claims.actual_learning: Explicit past-week domain interference; all 13 printed tic-minus-pain mean differences positive (0.05–1.12), robust only to rounding uncertainty.
claims.claim_retained: Direct interference domains and individual qualitative priorities are informative.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Pain prevalence; adult-only estimate; paired significant/meaningful effect from marginal means; pain less important to everyone.
claims.remaining_unknown: Age≥18 domain summaries, valid/N/A counts and rules, matched n, covariance, instrument validation and care counts.
claims.decision: No pooled adult prevalence or pain-treatment effect; close pending public clarification.

claims.cohort_linkage: 28 CTD and 34 control adults; overlap with other physiology cohorts not established.
claims.actual_learning: Reported gating nulls and smaller first-stimulus P50; required effect/variance/model quantities not retrieved.
claims.claim_retained: Counterevidence to a generalized deficit in this paradigm with unresolved precision.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Equivalence; every gating mechanism absent; S1 amplitude difference proves impaired gating.
claims.remaining_unknown: Full lawful methods/tables, index definitions, outcome-specific n, effect estimates/precision and relevant margin.
claims.decision: Close access pass until usable primary methods become available.

claims.source_type: Preprint plus linked historical registry results
claims.cohort_linkage: One 50-person ages 12–21 trial; publication and registry not independent.
claims.actual_learning: First posted 1 October, newly indexed during week; neural engagement and across-arm improvements reported; clinical contrasts and safety units ambiguous.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Added clinical benefit over sham, severe-adult efficacy, session-event rates are person risk, newly posted October trial results.
claims.remaining_unknown: Complete verified preprint methods, between-arm effects, endpoint hierarchy history, session/event/person denominators.
claims.decision: No clinical-effect reconstruction from ambiguous registry cells.

claims.cohort_linkage: 136 children; overlap with other reports unverified.
claims.actual_learning: First online 1 October3; association between allergy-load index and tic severity.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Allergy causes tics; treating allergy improves tics; adult extrapolation.
claims.remaining_unknown: Full adjustment/index construction, precision, selection, temporal order and overlap.
claims.decision: Retain as association, no clinical action.

claims.cohort_linkage: 34 adult interviewees; overlap and severe-state representation unverified.
claims.actual_learning: First online 1 October5; stigma, work and relationship themes.
claims.claim_retained: Adult participation/social burden is relevant independently of tic-score change.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Representative theme prevalence, treatment efficacy or validated prospective life-course model.
claims.remaining_unknown: Full recruitment/analysis methods, negative cases, geography and severe/comorbid applicability.

claims.cohort_linkage: Repeated postings recheck the same records; no distinct trial count per day.
claims.actual_learning: Adult physiology has no results; ecopipam expanded access temporarily unavailable; cell protocol withdrawn with zero enrollment; API coverage improved.
claims.claim_retained: Status, planned design and documented feasibility limits.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Updates are efficacy; zero-enrollment withdrawal is failed clinical efficacy; posting date is date status changed; query zero means worldwide absence.
claims.remaining_unknown: Full history, status-change dates/reasons, WHO/CTIS completeness.

claims.source_type: Integrity metadata, case report and regulator communications
claims.cohort_linkage: Do not count retraction notice or repeated safety metadata as independent clinical evidence.
claims.actual_learning: Historical July preclinical retraction excluded; general signal-only case; document update/recall/risk-communication dates distinct.
claims.claim_retained: Preserve integrity exclusions and official, context-specific safety information.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Retracted mechanism necessarily false; case establishes risk incidence; no new verified notice means safe; routine document/footer date means new warning.
claims.remaining_unknown: Retraction reason, complete safety labeling and filtered recall coverage.
claims.decision: No personal treatment-change instruction; preserve exact source and access limits.

claims.source_type: Historical crossover trial, incomplete primary access
claims.cohort_linkage: One historical trial; abstract identifies 18 completers, not verified pain n.
claims.actual_learning: Lawful NIHR secondary review corroborates a treated-tic-area pain measure under Safety, with scale unreported. Required primary methods/tables remain inaccessible.
claims.claim_retained: Pain measurement has secondary corroboration; precise construct, benefit versus procedural pain and primary estimator remain unverified.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Pain not measured; tic reduction proves pain relief; abstract secondary null proves pain equivalence.
claims.remaining_unknown: Endpoint wording/validation, denominators, crossover carryover/period treatment, paired pain estimate and precision.
claims.decision: Retire absence inference; stop primary-source gate and do not compute pain efficacy from secondary standardized figures.

claims.source_type: Deterministic audit of fixed published report set
claims.cohort_linkage: Three publications resolve to two independent trial clusters: NCT02605902 and NCT00231985.
claims.actual_learning: Endpoint/time/selection/exposure classifications prevent report-count inflation and unsupported cessation-based functional follow-up claims.
claims.claim_retained: This bounded report set does not document the stronger randomized post-cessation functional-benefit predicate.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: Analyst blocks or checks are independent clinical evidence; lack of documented conjunction proves no benefit; pooled efficacy from unlike endpoints.
claims.remaining_unknown: No new outcomes, joint covariance or clinical data generated. Structural predicates inherit source-coding uncertainty; this is not clinical validation.
claims.decision: Use as evidence-structure validation, not meta-analysis or treatment ranking.
claims.verification: 24 mechanical tests passed; a separate rerun was byte-identical and passed five additional count/status assertions, with source/interpretation review against prior audits.

claims.cohort_linkage: Hypotheses are not experiments or discoveries.
claims.actual_learning: No direct test of durable synergy, mechanism-specific MNS, personalized matching or resilience occurred this week.
claims.claim_retained: Established symptomatic anchors remain while speculative extensions require discriminating tests.
claims.unsupported_inference_retired: A new report, arithmetic check, in-sample prediction or symptom benefit establishes a cure mechanism.
claims.remaining_unknown: Causal pathways, clinically meaningful patient-relevant outcomes, independent replication and governed clinical access.
claims.decision: Keep speculative, not rejected wholesale or promoted.
